title: DTG AdmissionVouch (vouch@2, wire 0.24 family)
description: One member's vouching statement for one admission candidate as a conformant DTG EndorsementCredential (DTGWG Core Credentials WD01; Access 4.2/4.3/5.3). Endorsement vocabulary AdmissionVouch is community-defined by the Access layer: genesisDigest binds the group, accept binds the consented candidacy (no standing vouch), provenance is self-asserted. Proof: DataIntegrityProof eddsa-jcs-2022 incl. the mandatory proof @context copy.

validFrom.description: RFC3339 UTC 'Z', at most 3 fractional-second digits, 24 characters maximum — the Encounter 2.3 securing profile's timestamp language, shared verbatim by all three RLTP credential schemas: a syntactic gate, calendar validity is a parse-time check.

genesisDigest.description: multibase(multihash sha2-256) per Encounter 2.3: emit u, accept u/z; algorithm and length are checked at parse

accept.description: multibase(multihash sha2-256) per Encounter 2.3: emit u, accept u/z; algorithm and length are checked at parse

created.description: RFC3339 UTC 'Z', at most 3 fractional-second digits, 24 characters maximum — the Encounter 2.3 securing profile's timestamp language, shared verbatim by all three RLTP credential schemas: a syntactic gate, calendar validity is a parse-time check.

proofValue.description: multibase base58btc of an Ed25519 signature (exactly 64 bytes): 'z' plus 64 to 88 base58 characters — the Encounter 2.3 form, shared verbatim by all three RLTP credential schemas.
